Fixes for the two advisories published on 2026-11-04, a series genre action that wiped book details, and two import improvements. If you run Bindery with `BINDERY_ENFORCE_TENANCY` on and more than one account, or with local sign in turned off, please update.

### Security
- **Shared authors no longer show other users' books** (#3625, [GHSA-q8wp-7gh7-4873](https://github.com/vavallee/bindery/security/advisories/GHSA-q8wp-7gh7-4873)). With `BINDERY_ENFORCE_TENANCY` on, a shared author can hold books from seve

- **History, Refresh all and recommendations stay within each user's library** (#3587). With `BINDERY_ENFORCE_TENANCY` on, deleting a book used to leave its history (release names, indexers and import paths) visible to every user, and any user could delete those entries or blocklist their releases. History entries now belong to an account and stay with it after the book is gone; entries with no owner and no book are admin only. A user who is not an admin could also run Refresh all over every account's autho
- **SQLite driver updated** (#3510). The bundled `modernc.org/sqlite` goes from 1.60.1 to 1.61.0, which brings SQLite 3.54.1. No settings or data changes are needed.

- **Request front ends can file a request as the person who asked** (#3337, #3389). `POST /api/v1/requests` takes an optional `forUser` user id from an admin session or the API key, so an app that keeps its own users can make each request as that person instead of as the first admin. The request is theirs: it shows on their My requests, counts against their pending limit, and approves itself only if their account has auto-approve on. ### GitHub presentation
- Replace the stacked raster header with one responsive SVG composition using the supplied neon skull mark and vector neon lettering. Keep attribution and use a dedicated compact layout on narrow screens.
- Simplify the opening copy and navigation while keeping privacy/default controls visible. No runtime or stored-data changes.

Npm publishing is a separate, manual maintainer step.

### GitHub repository rename
- Rename the GitHub repository to `rustytensor/pi-noodle` and update current repository, issue, badge and image links. Prior release records remain unchanged.
- No runtime, stored-data, command or tool behavior changes. npm publication remains manual.
